exercises.title: Foreign keys without an index
concepts: cost of deleting a parent row
exercises.problemHtml:
Item 8 of the checklist. List every single-column foreign key of CT Shop whose column is not the first column of any index on its table: table_name, fk_column, references_table, ordered by table then column. (A primary key or UNIQUE that starts with the column counts as an index.)

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • conkey[1] is the FK column number (arrays start at 1); indkey[0] is the first column of an index (int2vector starts at 0).
  • Join pg_attribute to turn the number into a name.

product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,

payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)

Đúng 8 bảng của Lab 1–9 (ở schema public thay vì shop); dữ liệu là một lát nhỏ của dữ liệu lab — cùng cây danh mục, cùng id/SKU/giá sản phẩm. Mọi id là GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: bỏ cột id khi INSERT. Thời gian là timestamptz hiển thị theo giờ Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Script đầy đủ: tab ctshop.sql.

  • Nối pg_attribute để đổi số thành tên.

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT c.conrelid::regclass::text AS table_name,
       a.attname AS fk_column,
       c.confrelid::regclass::text AS references_table
FROM pg_constraint c
JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = c.conkey[1]
WHERE c.contype = 'f'
  AND array_length(c.conkey, 1) = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (                                   -- no index whose FIRST column is the FK column
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i
        WHERE i.indrelid = c.conrelid AND i.indkey[0] = c.conkey[1])
ORDER BY table_name, fk_column;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: PostgreSQL indexes the referenced side (it must be unique) but never the referencing side. Without one, deleting a customer scans orders and review to check the constraint, and joins from the parent are scans. On the site's real schema this query found 187 — each needs a decision (how parents are deleted, how big the table is), not a blind loop of CREATE INDEX.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: PostgreSQL đánh chỉ mục phía được tham chiếu (bắt buộc unique) nhưng không bao giờ phía tham chiếu. Thiếu nó, xoá một khách sẽ quét orders và review để kiểm ràng buộc, và phép nối từ bảng cha là quét. Trên lược đồ thật của web truy vấn này tìm ra 187 — mỗi cái cần một quyết định (bảng cha bị xoá thế nào, bảng lớn cỡ nào), không phải một vòng CREATE INDEX mù quáng.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.title: The checklist as one query
exercises.problemHtml:
Turn five checklist items into one query returning item, value, ok, ordered by item, with exactly these item labels:

  • 1 idle_in_transaction_session_timeout — ok when not 0
  • 2 statement_timeout — ok when not 0
  • 3 log_lock_waits — ok when on
  • 4 foreign keys without an index — value = the count as text, ok when 0
  • 5 INVALID indexes (failed CONCURRENTLY) — value = the count as text, ok when 0

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • current_setting('name') returns the effective value as text.
  • A failed CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY leaves an index with indisvalid = false.

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT '1 idle_in_transaction_session_timeout' AS item,
       current_setting('idle_in_transaction_session_timeout') AS value,
       current_setting('idle_in_transaction_session_timeout') <> '0' AS ok
UNION ALL
SELECT '2 statement_timeout', current_setting('statement_timeout'), current_setting('statement_timeout') <> '0'
UNION ALL
SELECT '3 log_lock_waits', current_setting('log_lock_waits'), current_setting('log_lock_waits') = 'on'
UNION ALL
SELECT '4 foreign keys without an index', count(*)::text, count(*) = 0
FROM pg_constraint c
WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indrelid = c.conrelid AND i.indkey[0] = c.conkey[1])
UNION ALL
SELECT '5 INVALID indexes (failed CONCURRENTLY)', count(*)::text, count(*) = 0

exercises.title: Which failure does each item prevent?
exercises.problemHtml:
Match each checklist item with the failure it prevents.

This set has 1 table. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper or in psql on your own PostgreSQL), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Ghép mỗi mục checklist với sự cố nó ngăn.

Bộ này có 1 bảng. Không có gì để chạy: trả lời trong khung bên phải rồi bấm Nộp. Hãy tự giải trước (ra giấy hoặc chạy trong psql trên PostgreSQL của bạn) rồi mới kiểm — giải thích sau khi Nộp nói rõ vì sao phương án "trông đúng" lại sai.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
